thread:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: SEV2 page — spike in 5xx from clients in ap-southeast for services hosted in az-16. Symptoms look like v6 path MTU / discovery failures. Paging oncall.

oncall_nora: I’m on it. grabbing recent dashboards, will hand to SRE if need be.

sre_miguel: oncall here — can you post quick TL;DR on customer impact and any recent deploys to az-16?

oncall_nora: no prod deploys in az-16 in last 2 hours. metrics: 5xx rate from az-16 -> up 7x since 14:02 UTC; latency tail also increased. Affected endpoints: /generate, /embed.

netops_lee: I’m running a few connectivity checks now, starting with traceroute and mtr over v6 from edge gw.

netops_lee: mtr to 2001:db8::client-ip shows huge packet loss after our egress hop:
```
AS12345  192.0.2.1   0.7%  
AS23456  2001:db8:fe::1  80%  (last good)
AS23456  2001:db8:fe::2  98%  (next hop)
```

sre_miguel: hunch: PMTUD probes (ICMPv6 frag needed / too big) are being dropped upstream. Any signs of jumbo frames or MTU mismatch?

netops_lee: we pushed a jumbo frame optimization for az-16 hosts earlier this month but reverted; config shows default mtu 1500. I see Path MTU messages in kernel logs: "icmpv6: fragmentation needed but DF set" from our egress interface.

eng_alyssa: we saw some client errors with "write: message too long" in app logs which matches MTU/fragmentation. Not all clients — mostly clients that resolve AAAA and prefer v6.

pm_jordan: Customer impact list? which customers are hitting errors?

customer_success_sam: CS: two high-rev customers reported timeouts in ap-southeast at 14:10 UTC. They're on dual-stack and set prefer IPv6. I opened tickets and told them we're investigating.

sre_miguel: mitigation options: a) enable MSS clamping on the egress gateway so endpoints reduce segment sizes; b) steer outgoing traffic from az-16 to az-17 (fallback to IPv4-first) via route policy; c) apply temporary NAT64/IPv6 fallback — risky. Thoughts?

netops_lee: I can apply MSS clamp quickly on the edge NAT boxes: iptables --set-mss 1220 on TCP SYN fiddles. That should buy time. Also can announce more specific IPv6 route via BGP to push traffic to az-17.

oncall_nora: do MSS clamp first, low risk. netops, proceed and patch notes in #eng-ops.

netops_lee: applying MSS clamp now on egress pool-az16-*. Running command:
```bash
for i in $(cat pool-az16-nodes); do ssh $i "iptables -t mangle -A POSTROUTING -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --set-mss 1220"; done
```

netops_lee: applied to 6 nodes, verifying.

eng_alyssa: I’m tailing app logs — error rate dropping on flows that retried to IPv4, but still some v6 sessions failing.

sre_miguel: good. next: we should reduce IPv6 preference for LB in az-16 so new connections prefer IPv4. Eng, can you flip weigh/order for AAAA/ A in the LB for az-16? low-risk flag.

eng_alyssa: I can push change to LB weights: set ip_preference=ipv4 for az-16 pools. Will do canary then roll.

eng_alyssa: canary done -> 10% of traffic now IPv4-first for az-16. Monitoring.

oncall_nora: notify customers about in-progress mitigation and ETA ~15m: "We see v6 path discovery failures for az-16; temporary routing and MSS fixes applied; teams monitoring."

customer_success_sam: notified impacted customers and offered IP fallback steps. They asked for status updates every 30m.

sre_miguel: metrics update: 5xx rate back down to baseline after MSS clamp + LB weight change. v6-only flows still flaky but significantly reduced user impact.

netops_lee: For long-term: need to engage provider on ICMPv6 filtering on their egress. Filing ticket with transit provider referencing dropped ICMPv6 "Fragmentation Needed" and path MTU failure.

pm_jordan: open an incident ticket and link to provider ticket. assign postmortem to eng_alyssa + netops_lee. Add action items: provider escalation, automated MSS clamp during similar incidents, and improved synthetic v6 PMTUD checks.

sre_miguel: will hand over to day SRE. @oncall_nora handing to @oncall_ash for follow-up and postmortem. leaving notes: exact commands used, timeline, customer notices.

oncall_nora: handing off to oncall_ash — summary posted in the incident doc. Marking page resolved for now; please watch for re-occurrence. :white_check_mark:

oncall_ash: ack and taking over. I’ll coordinate the provider ticket and schedule postmortem. Thanks team.

customer_success_sam: customers acknowledged update and will wait for postmortem.

pagerbot: Incident status -> resolved -> no active page. Incident ID INC-1975312468. Severity downgraded to P2 for postmortem work.

sre_miguel: closing thread here. Please add any follow-ups to the incident doc. Great work on rapid mitigation.
